children: RXO reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.87 billion, up 31.7% year over year. Net income was $3 million, compared with a $14 million loss a year earlier, while diluted EPS was $0.02 versus a loss of $0.08 per share.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Earnings (loss) per share”.
Truck brokerage revenue per load increased 48% and load volume grew 2%. Tighter capacity pushed carrier buy rates up faster than contractual sell rates.
Last mile revenue rose $29 million, supported by 5% volume growth and 4% rate growth. Managed transportation revenue increased $26 million.
Selling, general and administrative expense fell to 11.9% of revenue from 14.6%, reflecting restructuring savings and improved operating leverage.
RXO agreed to be acquired by C.H. Robinson. The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027, subject to approvals and customary conditions.
